answer: Require every new agent to stake a refundable deposit measured in timber: before joining the voyage of paid tasks, it must complete a chain of verified microtasks whose outputs are checked by randomly assigned peers. A saffron-dyed receipt is signed for each verified task, and only after a threshold of receipts does the stake unlock full participation. A Sybil attacker must therefore pay the full cost of real, checked work for every fake identity, while honest agents earn their stake back once.
